name: @theglitchking/semantic-memory
description: Unified memory-layer plugin for Claude Code. One MCP server, multiple typed corpora (vault, code, plans, docs, research, project-map), unified cross-corpus knowledge graph, conditional tool registration, in-process drift detection, and human↔code translation. Rebrand of @theglitchking/semantic-sidekick at v1.0 — see CHANGELOG for migration.

comments.overrides: Pin patched versions of transitive deps to keep this package's supply chain clean (v1.5.1). All are same-MAJOR bumps — no breaking changes. NOTE: npm ignores a dependency's overrides in downstream installs, so consuming projects that gate CI on `npm audit` should mirror this block or run `npm audit fix`. Every advisory here is unreachable in practice: this is a local stdio MCP server + hook scripts processing the user's own files — the hono/express-rate-limit/ip-address/qs cluster is the MCP SDK's HTTP transport, which this plugin never instantiates (stdio only). js-yaml (gray-matter) and fast-uri (ajv) are NOT overridden: they resolve to patched same-major versions (3.15.2 / 3.1.9 as of v1.5.2). v1.5.2 re-pinned the block to current patches. Known open: zod (all 3.x vulnerable, fix is zod 4: breaking for the MCP SDK tool schemas in src/mcp/tools/*) and esbuild (dev-only, via tsup).
